question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birth_date's year + 25 <= 2026 and (birth_date's month, day) <= (09-25)
    -- and (birth_date's month, day) > (09-25) is false (i.e., not after)
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 <= 2026
    AND
    (
      CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
      <=
      CAST('2026-09-25' AS INTEGER) * 10000 + 9 * 100 + 25
    )
    AND NOT (
      CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
      >
      CAST('2026-09-25' AS INTEGER) * 10000 + 9 * 100 + 25
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date <= '2026-09-24' AND c.birth_date > date('2026-09-24', '-26 years')
AND date('2026-09-24') >= c.birth_date AND date('2026-09-24') < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years');

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    -- Subtract 1 if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year on 2026-09-26
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
  AND CAST(strftime('%m-%d', o.date) >= CAST(strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS TEXT) AS INTEGER) = 1;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) AND
     strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years')) OR
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') AND
     strftime('%Y-%m-%d', '2026-09-25') < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years'))
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a','b','c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
  AND (
        CASE
          WHEN substr(c.birth_date,6,2)||'-'||substr(c.birth_date,1,4) <= '09-25'
          THEN strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - substr(c.birth_date,7,4)
          ELSE strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - substr(c.birth_date,7,4) - 1
        END
      ) = 25;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    (
      substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 <= substr(o.date, 1, 4)
      AND (
        (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 7, 2)) <= (substr(o.date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(o.date, 7, 2))
        OR (substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 < substr(o.date, 1, 4))
      )
    )
    OR (
      substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) + 25 = substr(o.date, 1, 4)
      AND (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(c.birth_date, 7, 2)) <= (substr(o.date, 6, 2) || '-' || substr(o.date, 7, 2))
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.birth_date <= date('2026-09-25', '-' || CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) || '-01-01')
  AND c.birth_date > date('2026-09-25', '-' || CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 1) AS INTEGER) || '-01-01');
